title: Ancient goddess, ancient glow-up.
caption: In the Sumerian myth, Inanna passes seven gates and leaves something behind at each. Venus follows along with seven keepsakes from her exes. What you set down after a breakup can help you rise lighter. What would you leave at the gate?
